title: Shadow credit docking and invoice rollback procedure for mid-cycle contract amendments
creator: Priya Nair
description: Problem: When enterprise customers request mid-cycle contract amendments (reserved capacity increases, downgrade, or term changes) we currently create manual credits and pro-rated invoices. Edge cases observed: overlapping reserved-capacity refunds and overage charges in the same cycle, negative provisional balances causing downstream invoice generation failures, and security-questionnaire holds that block payment while usage continues. This ticket defines an automated "shadow credit docking" flow (temporary non-invoice ledger entries), explicit rollback steps, and customer communication templates to eliminate manual reconciliation and reduce refunds/chargeback incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow credit ledger entries created automatically for contract amendments within 2 minutes of request approval
Invoice generation pipeline skips write of shadow credits to final invoice until amendment is finalized or reconciliation window closes
Automated rollback API (internal) can reverse shadow credits and reapply original meter state with audit trail
No downstream negative-balance invoice failures for 30 consecutive days in pilot customers (N=10)
Customer-facing invoice attachments include a one-page amendment summary and provisional credit explanation
tasks: Design ledger schema for temporary (shadow) credits that are readable by billing UI but excluded from legal invoices
Define event contract: amendment-approved -> create-shadow-credit event -> mark-ttl (14 days) -> finalize-or-reverse
Build reconciliation worker that finalizes shadow credits at EOD or reverses based on finalized amendment status
Add safety rails: max provisional credit per org, guardrails for negative effective balance, and automatic customer notif triggers
Create email + invoice attachment templates and update self-serve contract amendment page copy
Coordinate with Security/Legal on treatment of invoice holds from security questionnaires (SQR) and ensure auditability

rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): Feature flag enabled for 10 enterprise orgs. Monitor provisional credit volume and invoice generation errors.
Phase 2: Open beta for all enterprise orgs with opt-in; add automatic email templates and customer-facing invoice attachments.
Phase 3: Default on for all customers and remove manual reconciliation playbook; enable telemetry to detect regressions
testing_notes: Create unit tests for idempotent create/reverse operations
Integration tests: amendment-approved -> shadow credit created -> finalize -> invoice shows credit
Edge case tests: amendment-revoked before finalization, SQR hold applied and then released, negative balance guardrails
Manual QA checklist for pilot customers: verify invoice attachment content, verify no failed invoice writes to payment gateway
